sentences.en: JACK: Lucy, we really need to get working on this marketing assignment
sentences.zh: JACK: 露西，我们真的得赶紧开始做这个市场营销作业了。

sentences.en: We've only got five weeks left to the end of term to design it, carry it out, and then write up the results
sentences.zh: 我们离学期结束只剩五周时间，要完成设计、实施，再撰写结果报告。

sentences.en: LUCY: Sure
sentences.zh: LUCY: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, let's get started right now
sentences.zh: 那我们现在就马上开始吧。

sentences.en: Let's go over the instructions
sentences.zh: 我们先一起看看作业要求。

sentences.en: What exactly do we have to do?
sentences.zh: 我们到底需要做些什么？

sentences.en: JACK: Well, it says here we have to look at one area of the entertainment industry
sentences.zh: JACK: 嗯，这里写着我们必须研究娱乐产业中的一个领域。

sentences.en: There's a list of the different types
sentences.zh: 后面列出了几个不同类别。

sentences.en: LUCY: What are they?
sentences.zh: LUCY: 都有哪些？

sentences.en: JACK: Music, cinema, theatre, sport, and cating out
sentences.zh: JACK: 音乐、电影、戏剧、体育，以及外出就餐。

sentences.en: LUCY: Is that all?
sentences.zh: LUCY: 就这些吗？

sentences.en: JACK: Looks like it
sentences.zh: JACK: 看起来是的。

sentences.en: LUCY: So we choose one branch of the industry and then we look at how two different groups of people use it?
sentences.zh: LUCY: 所以我们要选该产业中的一个分支，然后考察两个不同人群如何使用它？

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 对吗？

sentences.en: JACK: Yes
sentences.zh: JACK: 对。

sentences.en: LUCY: And do we have to use any particular method to get our data?
sentences.zh: LUCY: 那我们在收集数据时，必须采用某种特定方法吗？

sentences.en: Can we mail out a questionnaire, or do face-to-face interviews, or maybe even observations?
sentences.zh: 我们可以邮寄问卷，或进行面对面访谈，甚至还可以做实地观察？

sentences.en: SLA
sentences.zh: SLA

sentences.en: JACK: Well actually, it looks like we don't telephone interviews
sentences.zh: JACK: 嗯，实际上，看起来我们不能采用电话访谈。

sentences.en: LUCY: have a choir Vehpe sode S a g OK, so at least we don't have to waste time deciding between the different methods
sentences.zh: LUCY: （听不清）……好的，至少我们不用花时间在不同方法之间做选择了。

sentences.en: JACK: Yeah, that's right
sentences.zh: JACK: 没错。

sentences.en: Oh, and the other requirement is the number of interviewees
sentences.zh: 哦，还有另一项要求是受访者人数。

sentences.en: LUCY: Not too many, I hope
sentences.zh: LUCY: 希望别太多吧。

sentences.en: Ten?
sentences.zh: 十个？

sentences.en: Twenty?
sentences.zh: 二十个？

sentences.en: JACK: Well, we have to do two groups, remember, and it looks like we have to interview fifteen for cach group
sentences.zh: JACK: 嗯，我们得调查两个群体，记得吧？而且看起来每个群体要访谈十五人。

sentences.en: LUCY: That's thirty altogether then
sentences.zh: LUCY: 那总共就是三十人了。

sentences.en: It's going to take ages
sentences.zh: 这得花很长时间。

sentences.en: JACK: Yes, but remember we're working on this together, so we'll only have to do fifteen each
sentences.zh: JACK: 是啊，但别忘了我们是两人合作，所以每人只需负责十五人。

sentences.en: LUCY: OK, so those are all the requirements?
sentences.zh: LUCY: 好的，这些就是全部要求了吗？

sentences.en: JACK: Yes, looks like it
sentences.zh: JACK: 是的，看起来是这样。

sentences.en: LUCY: So, first, which area are we going to choose?
sentences.zh: LUCY: 那么，首先我们选哪个领域呢？

sentences.en: My preference would be cinema, since that's where spend most of my money
sentences.zh: 我个人倾向选电影，因为我在那上面花的钱最多。

sentences.en: JACK: Hmm, I don't think that's such a good idea
sentences.zh: JACK: 嗯，我觉得这主意不太妙。

sentences.en: I don't think there are huge differences in the market there
sentences.zh: 我认为该市场的差异并不大。

sentences.en: I mean you get young and old, male and female, rich and poor all going to the same movies
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，年轻人和老年人、男性和女性、富人和穷人，都会去看同一部电影。

sentences.en: LUCY: Yeah, maybe you're right
sentences.zh: LUCY: 嗯，也许你说得对。

sentences.en: Let's make it music then
sentences.zh: 那我们就选音乐吧。

sentences.en: JACK: Right
sentences.zh: JACK: 好的。

sentences.en: So, what two groups will we compare and contrast?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们将比较和对比哪两个群体？

sentences.en: LUCY: Male and female?
sentences.zh: LUCY: 男性和女性？

sentences.en: JACK: No
sentences.zh: JACK: 不是。

sentences.en: Most of my female friends like the same music as me
sentences.zh: 我大多数女性朋友和我喜欢的音乐是一样的。

sentences.en: Different age groups would be much more likely to show up differences, think
sentences.zh: 不同年龄群体更有可能显示出差异，想想看。

sentences.en: LUCY: Yeah, I suppose you're right again
sentences.zh: LUCY: 嗯，我想你又说对了。

sentences.en: I'll take some notes, shall I?
sentences.zh: 我来记些笔记，好吗？

sentences.en: So
sentences.zh: 那么……

sentences.en: Age Groups
sentences.zh: 年龄群体。

sentences.en: Well
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你们怎么看？

sentences.en: Maybe twenty-five or under for onc group, and forty-five or over for the other group?
sentences.zh: 也许一组是25岁及以下，另一组是45岁及以上？

sentences.en: That should show up differences
sentences.zh: 这样应该能显示出差异。

sentences.en: JACK: Right
sentences.zh: JACK: 没错。

sentences.en: LUCY: OK
sentences.zh: LUCY: 好的。

sentences.en: Next
sentences.zh: 接下来。

sentences.en: How about the kind of music they like - let's give them some choices and then we can just tick boxes
sentences.zh: 关于他们喜欢的音乐类型——我们给他们一些选项，然后只需勾选即可。

sentences.en: JACK: OK
sentences.zh: JACK: 好的。

sentences.en: Let's have pop, jazz, folk, casy listening
sentences.zh: 我们设为流行乐、爵士乐、民谣、轻松聆听……

sentences.en: What else?
sentences.zh: 还有别的吗？

sentences.en: LUCY: Well, we should include classical
sentences.zh: LUCY: 嗯，我们应该包括古典音乐。

sentences.en: Some people like it, you know
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些人喜欢它。

sentences.en: JACK: OK
sentences.zh: JACK: 好的。

sentences.en: OK
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And then we should have how they listen to music
sentences.zh: 接着，我们还应考虑他们听音乐的方式。

sentences.en: LUCY: The medium
sentences.zh: LUCY: 即媒介。

sentences.en: Right
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Let's include radio, CD - and then I guess there's TV
sentences.zh: 我们把收音机、CD列入其中——然后我想电视也算一种。

sentences.en: JACK: What about concerts?
sentences.zh: JACK: 那现场音乐会呢？

sentences.en: You know, in pubs and halls
sentences.zh: 比如在酒吧和礼堂举办的那种。

sentences.en: LUCY: Oh yeah, we should include live music of course
sentences.zh: LUCY: 哦，对，我们当然应该包括现场音乐。

sentences.en: JACK: OK, we're on a roll now!
sentences.zh: JACK: 太好了，我们现在进展顺利！

sentences.en: Next point could be about where they actually get their music
sentences.zh: 下一个要点可以是关于他们实际获取音乐的渠道。

sentences.en: LUCY: You mean like, do they buy it in music shops, or department stores?
sentences.zh: LUCY: 你的意思是，他们是去唱片店或百货商店购买，还是从互联网下载？

sentences.en: JACK: Yes, or download it from the Internet
sentences.zh: JACK: 对，或者从互联网下载。

sentences.en: LUCY: Right
sentences.zh: LUCY: 明白了。

sentences.en: That could be for recorded music
sentences.zh: 这可以用于录制音乐。

sentences.en: Then we need another section for live music
sentences.zh: 然后我们需要另设一个部分来涵盖现场音乐。

sentences.en: Where do they go for that?
sentences.zh: 他们去那里做什么？

sentences.en: JACK: OK
sentences.zh: JACK: 好的。

sentences.en: Let's say disco, pub, club, concert hall
sentences.zh: 比如说迪斯科舞厅、酒吧、夜总会、音乐厅……

sentences.en: LUCY: Or opera house!
sentences.zh: LUCY: 或者歌剧院！

sentences.en: And I guess we should include karaoke bars
sentences.zh: 我想我们还应该把卡拉OK酒吧包括在内。

sentences.en: JACK: Not many of them in this city!
sentences.zh: JACK: 这座城市里可没几家！

sentences.en: LUCY: OK
sentences.zh: LUCY: 好的。

sentences.en: We'll leave that out then
sentences.zh: 那我们就把它去掉吧。

sentences.en: So, what's left to do?
sentences.zh: 那么，还剩下什么要做？

sentences.en: JACK: That's it
sentences.zh: JACK: 就这些了。

sentences.en: Well, now we can make a time-scale for doing it
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在我们可以制定一个时间进度表来完成这项工作。
